summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Nounou Connect CI. All 45 pytest tests passed (100% success rate) covering auth (register/login/me/logout with cookie+bearer), profile CRUD for nounou & parent (with role enforcement), nanny search with all filters (quartier, availability, min_experience, max_rate, care_type, search), phone privacy (hidden in list & for non-accepted matches, revealed after accepted match), match creation/listing/update/delete with role enforcement, notifications (created on request and on status change, mark read, mark all read, unread counter), public stats, validation (invalid phone -> 422, short password -> 422, duplicate phone -> 400, wrong password -> 401).

minor.issue: Returns the underlying Mongo document via find_one without _id projection; if subsequent code path serialized it, it could leak. Currently safe because only used for permission check, but recommend projecting {'_id': 0} for consistency.
match dict is inserted by Mongo which mutates it adding _id; code calls match.pop('_id', None) before return which works, but better to project after insert.
Response 'match' object reflects updated status manually but does not include updated_at refresh in the returned dict (DB is correct, response slightly stale).
Uses user_id as path param but route is named nanny_id; semantics OK. Consider explicit naming in docs.
secure=False on auth cookie. Acceptable for preview env but should be True in production behind HTTPS.

action_items: Optional: set cookie secure=True in production
Optional: add rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (none currently)
Optional: add pagination to /api/nannies (currently capped at 200)
critical_code_review_comments: No brute-force protection on /auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout - not implemented). Not a regression for first MVP but flag.
JWT_SECRET is committed in .env; ensure it is rotated for production.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec - browsers will reject credentialed requests from wildcard origin. Should set explicit origins (e.g., FRONTEND_URL) when credentials are used.
server.py is 461 lines - acceptable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers if it grows.
Phone normalization allows generic 8-15 digit format rather than enforcing Ivorian +225 prefix - intentionally permissive.
test_credentials: Dynamically generated unique phones per test run (TS suffix). Sample: parent +2250700000001 / Test1234 (pre-seeded), nounou +2250700000002 / Test1234.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates 3 fresh users (parent + 2 nannies) with unique phone numbers using current timestamp suffix; profiles & matches are created and partially cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_nounou.py is fully reusable and self-contained (uses unique phones each run, no manual cleanup needed). All endpoints listed in review request are covered. Note CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials issue if frontend needs cookie-based auth from browser - frontend will need to use Bearer token instead, OR backend needs explicit origin.
